solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: His Excellency has brother about town on the West Bank

parts.note: HE is the standard abbreviation for His Excellency, an ambassador's title
on means about, as in a talk on a subject

explanation.surface: An ambassador's brother is travelling around a town in the West Bank.
explanation.definitionFit: Hebron is a city in the occupied West Bank, south of Jerusalem.

clue.text: Old football ground in London for eminent Lancashire team

parts.note: high means eminent, of high rank
Bury FC is a football club from the Lancashire town of Bury

explanation.surface: A famous Lancashire side plays at an old London stadium.
explanation.definitionFit: Highbury was Arsenal's home ground in north London until 2006.

clue.text: Fashionable part of the capital — three- quarters of another is by Roman road

indicators.note: three quarters says the last quarter of the eight-letter capital is cut off

parts.note: another capital, here the Serbian capital Belgrade
via is Latin for road, as in Via Appia

explanation.surface: A smart district of London borders another city along an old Roman highway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'another' means another capital, Belgrade; losing its last two letters leaves BELGRA.
explanation.definitionFit: Belgravia is an expensive, fashionable district of central London.

clue.text: State of leading healthy industrialists in spectacles

indicators.note: in puts the initials inside the spectacles

parts.note: a pair of glasses looks like two Os

indicators.note: leading picks the first letter of each of the following words

explanation.surface: A state of fit captains of industry wearing glasses.
explanation.definitionFit: Ohio is one of the United States.

clue.text: Welsh university town uprooted palm- tree

indicators.note: a tree pulled up from its roots is thrown into disorder, so its letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: In a Welsh college town a palm tree has been torn out of the ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Lampeter in Ceredigion is home to a campus of the University of Wales Trinity Saint David.

clue.text: North Lanarkshire town's salon equipment without covers

definitions.note: read as town is, the 's being a link

indicators.note: without covers says the outer letters are stripped off

parts.note: a hairdrier is used in a hairdresser's salon

explanation.surface: Hairdressing kit in a Scottish town is left uncovered.
explanation.definitionFit: Airdrie is a town in North Lanarkshire, Scotland, east of Glasgow.

clue.text: Standard president raised about state capital of Surinam

parts.note: par is the standard, as in up to par

indicators.note: about puts the reversed president around the state
in a down clue, raised means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: Barack Obama was a US president
RI is the abbreviation for Rhode Island

explanation.surface: A typical president lifted up and around a South American capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Standard' looks like an adjective for the president but gives the golfing par; in a down clue 'raised' reads upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Paramaribo is the capital and chief port of Suriname.

clue.text: Tumble-down gite on North Devon river

indicators.note: a tumble-down building is ruined, so the letters fall into a new order

explanation.surface: A ramshackle holiday cottage stands on a river in North Devon.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tumble-down' rearranges GITE into TEIG; the gite is a French holiday cottage.
explanation.definitionFit: The Teign is a river in Devon reaching the sea at Teignmouth.

clue.text: Count on Don in Russia!

definitions.meaning: Count ... is a noble in Tolstoy's War and Peace
A Russian city on the river Don

explanation.definitionFit: The name belongs both to a Tolstoy nobleman and to a large Russian river city.

clue.text: A Native American turned up without love in Caribbean capital

indicators.note: without says the following letter is removed
in a down clue, turned up means read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: the Navaho are a Native American people
love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: A Native American appeared, without romance, in a Caribbean city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned up' makes A NAVAHO into OHAVANA, and 'without' drops the O.
explanation.definitionFit: Havana is the capital of Cuba, an island in the Caribbean.

clue.text: Grand galleries (not square) rebuilt in South Wales town

parts.note: G is the usual abbreviation for grand, a thousand pounds

indicators.note: something rebuilt is put together in a new shape, so the remaining letters are rearranged
not says the square's letter is left out of the galleries

parts.note: S is a short form for square, as in street names

explanation.surface: Impressive art galleries, apart from the one on the square, have been reconstructed in a Welsh town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grand' looks like praise of the galleries but is the abbreviation for a thousand pounds; 'not square' removes a single letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Gelligaer is a village and community in Caerphilly county borough, South Wales.

clue.text: Wretched miser in French city

indicators.note: something wretched is in a sorry state, signalling the letters are knocked out of order

explanation.surface: A miserable skinflint lives in a French city.
explanation.definitionFit: Reims is a city in Champagne, where French kings were crowned.

clue.text: Male singer lacking harmony at Adriatic seaport

indicators.note: lacking says the following piece is removed from the singer

parts.note: a baritone is a male singer between tenor and bass
tone can mean harmony of sound or colour

explanation.surface: A man who sings out of tune turns up in an Italian port.
explanation.definitionFit: Bari is the capital of Apulia, a major port on Italy's Adriatic coast.

clue.text: Bread and wine and a drop of oil in US city

parts.note: the Eucharist, in which bread and wine are shared, is a sacrament

indicators.note: a drop of says only a tiny bit, the first letter, of the following word is used

explanation.surface: Communion elements and some anointing oil are found in an American city.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a church service with anointing; the oil gives just its first letter O.
explanation.definitionFit: Sacramento is the state capital of California.

clue.text: Receive money for a piece of land in Cumbria

parts.note: to sell is to receive money for goods
a field is a piece of land

explanation.surface: Someone sells a plot of land in Cumbria.
explanation.walkthrough: CUMBRIA is a county in north-west England.
explanation.definitionFit: Sellafield is the nuclear site on the Cumbrian coast of north-west England.

clue.text: I arrive looking seedy on the Mediterranean

definitions.note: the definition reads as 'a place on the Mediterranean', a coastal strip

indicators.note: seedy means shabby and run down, so the letters appear in a dishevelled order

explanation.surface: A traveller turns up on the Mediterranean coast looking rather shabby.
explanation.definitionFit: The French and Italian Riviera is the coastal strip along the Mediterranean.

clue.text: Shout about headless fish and medicinal plant in county seat in 23

indicators.note: about here means turned round, so the pieces are read backwards
headless says the first letter of the fish is lopped off

parts.note: hake is a sea fish of the cod family
rue is a bitter herb once used in medicine

explanation.surface: Someone cries out over a fish without its head and a herbal remedy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shout' gives a second definition, the cry of discovery. AKE plus RUE is AKERUE, which 'about' turns round. 23 is CALIFORNIA.
explanation.definitionFit: Eureka is the county seat of Humboldt County in northern California.

clue.text: Speyside town where Sue, ski-ing, crashes

indicators.note: someone who crashes while skiing ends up in a heap, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: In a Highland resort a skier named Sue keeps falling over.
explanation.definitionFit: Kingussie is a small town in Badenoch on the River Spey, in the Scottish Highlands.

clue.text: Dad with downcast girl in city in 23

parts.note: pa is a familiar word for dad
downcast means sad
Ena is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A father and his gloomy daughter live in a Californian city.
explanation.definitionFit: Pasadena is a city in Los Angeles County, California.

clue.text: Stately home by a motorway in Nick Clegg's Sheffield constituency (and shire)

parts.note: a country house is often called a Hall
M is the abbreviation for motorway, as in M1

explanation.surface: A grand house next to the M1 lies in a former Liberal Democrat leader's Sheffield seat.
explanation.walkthrough: Hallamshire is the old name of the district round Sheffield, hence '(and shire)'.
explanation.definitionFit: Sheffield Hallam was the parliamentary seat held by the Liberal Democrat leader Nick Clegg.

clue.text: Extra weight in town on the Wirral

parts.note: more means extra
a ton is a unit of weight

explanation.surface: Someone puts on additional weight in a Merseyside town.
explanation.walkthrough: The Wirral is a peninsula on Merseyside, near Liverpool.
explanation.definitionFit: Moreton is a town on the Wirral peninsula in north-west England.

clue.text: Country's prohibition among other things

definitions.note: read as Country is, the 's being a link

indicators.note: among places the ban inside the other things

parts.note: alia is Latin for other things, as in et alia
a ban is a prohibition

explanation.surface: A nation's embargo sits alongside various other measures.
explanation.definitionFit: Albania is a Balkan nation on the Adriatic.

clue.text: French friend with sense, at heart, in the capital of Picardy

parts.note: ami is French for friend

indicators.note: at heart takes the central letters of the following word

explanation.surface: A sensible French companion lives in Picardy's chief city.
explanation.definitionFit: Amiens is the historic capital of the Picardy region of northern France.

clue.text: Goon's cake in town in Greater Manchester

definitions.meaning: A character in the radio comedy The Goon Show
an ... cake is a currant-filled pastry

explanation.surface: A comedian's pastry is found in a Manchester town.
explanation.walkthrough: The Goon Show was a 1950s BBC radio comedy; Eccles was one of its characters.
explanation.definitionFit: One name serves for a radio comic character, a currant pastry and the town both are named after.

clue.text: State of eastern potentate worried on air

parts.note: a calif or caliph is a Muslim ruler in the East

indicators.note: worried means agitated, so the letters are disturbed into a new order

explanation.surface: A ruler from the East becomes anxious when broadcasting.
explanation.definitionFit: California is one of the United States.

clue.text: Spanish poet rewrote carol in Murcia

indicators.note: rewrote says the letters of the song are written out in a new order

explanation.surface: A Spanish poet reworks a Christmas song.
explanation.walkthrough: Lorca is also a town in Murcia, south-east Spain, so 'in Murcia' completes a second definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Federico Garcia Lorca was a celebrated Spanish poet and playwright.

clue.text: Island mountains

definitions.meaning: An island of the Inner Hebrides in Scotland
a mountain range on the French-Swiss border

explanation.definitionFit: Two places share the name: a Hebridean island and an Alpine-foreland mountain range.

clue.text: Shetland isle up in the valleys

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the letters are read upwards, backwards
in says the letters lie within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A Shetland island rises up among the valleys.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' takes LLEY from valleys and 'up' turns it round.
explanation.definitionFit: Yell is the second largest island of the Shetland group.

clue.text: Some popular neighbours in port in Co. Antrim

indicators.note: Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some well-liked people next door live in a Northern Irish port.
explanation.walkthrough: The draft's definition began with 'in', which is a link word; the definition is 'port in Co. Antrim'.
explanation.definitionFit: Larne is a ferry port on the coast of County Antrim, Northern Ireland.

clue.text: State of a number on headland mid- week

parts.note: ten is a number
ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness or Dungeness

indicators.note: mid- says take the middle letters of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A state of affairs regarding a figure on a promontory in the middle of the week.
explanation.definitionFit: Tennessee is one of the United States.

clue.text: Land pigs turn over in Lincolnshire

indicators.note: to turn over the soil is to churn it, so the letters are churned

explanation.surface: Pigs root up the land on a Lincolnshire farm.
explanation.definitionFit: Spalding is a market town in the fens of south Lincolnshire, an English county.

clue.text: Emails spammed on Malta

indicators.note: spammed suggests junk sent out in a jumble, so the letters are scrambled

explanation.surface: Junk mail floods inboxes on a Mediterranean island.
explanation.definitionFit: Sliema is a resort town on the north-east coast of the island of Malta.
